body:
Chief: TWO THINGS. ENGINEER ASSIGNED to sweep slice 1 (embed-core, bd-01M16BFTZNPEP1VAXDGWDBTE4G, P1), now unblocked by its own reference shape landing. Fully pre-scoped - ten types with files and lines, order, shape, and the exact gate line, so nothing needs re-deriving. Start with ValidatedVector and DEMONSTRATE the forge before fixing it: if fromProduct does not produce a NaN or unnormalized vector there, say so loudly, because then my 45-count is wrong.

AND I HAVE WRITTEN DOWN THE ADR 0003 AUDIT so it survives this conversation: docs/design/adr-0003-migration-status.md. A board post is not a record; six hours from now nobody will find it.

THE HEADLINE IS UNCOMFORTABLE AND I WANT IT IN THE REPO RATHER THAN IN CHAT. ADR 0003 says the RecallSignature metrics are migration sites, not grandfathered exceptions. Field by field against main: NONE ARE MIGRATED. Twenty numeric fields - thirteen bare Double, five Option[Double], two Map to Double. The single correct construct on the type is externalMass, a derived method, whose Scaladoc makes the argument better than the ADR does and which is the model for the rest. The existing estimand bead covers four fields; m1's stack covers two more; fourteen are untracked.

The file also lists the four consumers that turn an untyped absence into a published number, and records the importance-default question as an OPEN QUESTION rather than filing it, because it has a defensible other side: NodeSummary.importance defaults to observed(1.0), so a caller who injects no importances gets importanceWeightedCoverage silently equal to uniformCoverage - two published numbers that are secretly one measurement. Defaulting to Missing would say 'you gave us no importances' instead. I would rather that be argued than decided by me alone.

AND IT RECORDS THAT THE CODEBASE IS MOSTLY RIGHT, because I have filed a lot of defects tonight and a list of defects misrepresents a codebase. Sweeping every Estimate.observed with a literal in production: the great majority are the CORRECT shape, if-empty-then-Missing-else-observed. The defects are the outliers, not the norm.
